loze / is Setting In

is Setting In

Property

The relation that obtains between an object o and an eventuality e if and only if o is the setting or context in which e is the case

For example

The organisation is the setting of a presidency, a living being is the setting in which an organ is vital, a wall is a partition in a house

Specialisation

Asserting a sub-property asserts its own domain and range, not just the parent's. Anything you put either side is taken to be of the narrower class, whether or not you said so.

isParticipantInEntity → Eventuality
isSettingInObject → Eventualitynarrows domain
Note

This thematic relation is intended for those eventualities that consist in roles, positions, or functions within a setting or an organised system; the participant that occupies the role is a theme in the eventuality

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
